decision: One controlled second connector reference attempt for the same immutable artifact, with robust envelope handling; then at most one first local stream if valid authorized file reference returned.
first_attempt: Raw envelope unretained; remote transfer unknown; structuredContent assumption failed before any local client.
response_handling: Persist sanitized envelope shape/error before dereferencing; accept one file_uri from structured data, JSON text or a documented resource link; enforce HTTPS artifact-service host; stop on explicit error/denial or ambiguous reference. Never retain signed URL.
not_a_retry_of_local_download: No prior local stream was started; original body/hash/TLS/V2/oracle gates unchanged.
